g.title: DetectionSoC
g.text: Multi-scale Feature Fusion + Convolution SoC | Implemented banked + prefetch architecture

g.title: cluster_accel
g.text: Accelerator: fixed 4 x 4 MAC array | 40 KiB SRAM implemented

g.title: mem
g.text: No full upsample / concat tensor in fused mode

g.title: bus
g.text: 32-bit native bus / CPU + DMA ROI counters

g.title: pool
g.text: Third DMA master, no scratch RAM

g.title: dma
g.text: Read two feature sources + weights / writeback

g.title: iq
g.text: Same rounding + saturation as CPU baseline

g.title: buf
g.text: B | X / W: 2 slots x 8 KiB each, four banks per slot

g.title: scatter
g.text: B | Replicate / scatter into current X tile
One sample in flight / scatter completes before next

g.title: gather
g.text: Padding / tails / no full im2col in main memory

g.title: core
g.text: C | 4 x 4 INT8 broadcast MAC / INT32 accumulate
